title: GameNative Duo settings for a game
description: Settings from the container's 'GameNative Duo' tab. Only the fields present are applied.

splitLayout.description: fill: tall window, both parts as wide as it; native: tall window, each part 1:1 with its display (dual-screen mods); region: the game unchanged on top, a magnified part of it on the bottom screen.

region.description: Region view: the part of the game the bottom screen shows, as fractions of the game screen "x,y,w,h" (reshaped to the bottom display's shape).
